Name: Pink Rain Over Pelican Town
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
"Pink Rain Over Pelican Town" is a whimsical and visually captivating mod for Stardew Valley that transforms the mundane rainy days into a stunning display of pink rain. Whether you're a seasoned farmer or just starting out on your agricultural journey, this mod adds a delightful touch of color to your gaming experience.
Features:
[list]
[*]Pink Rain Particles: This mod replaces the standard rain textures with charming pink raindrops that gently fall over the landscape. Each drop glistens with a soft, rosy hue, creating a serene and picturesque atmosphere during rainy days.
[*]Immersive and Atmospheric: Experience the magic of pink rain as it envelops Pelican Town and the surrounding countryside. The mod seamlessly integrates into the game, enhancing your overall Stardew Valley experience without disrupting its core gameplay.
[*]Seasonal Aesthetics: Watch as the pink rain complements the changing seasons, creating a different visual ambiance in each of Stardew Valley's unique seasons. From the delicate pinks of spring to the rich tones of fall, your farming journey will be accompanied by a dynamic and enchanting display.
[/list]Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/url]﻿ installed.
[*]Download the "Pink Rain Mod" from Nexus Mods.
[*]Extract the mod folder to your Stardew Valley mods directory (typically located in "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods").
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI to experience the pink rain.
[/list]Compatibility:
This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.5 and requires SMAPI 3.5 or higher.
Credits:
[list]
[*]GingerNinja7921: Creator of the Pink Rain Mod.
[*]Stardew Valley Community: For their ongoing support and inspiration.
[/list]Feedback and Support:
I value your feedback! If you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or simply want to share your experience with Pink Rain Over Pelican Town, please leave a comment on the mod page. We're here to help and make your time in Stardew Valley as enjoyable as possible.
